newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi Int'l postpones press conference.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi Int'l postpones press conference.

text.p: Bankrupt Kiwi International Air Lines, which was expected to outline its return to scheduled service Thursday, postponed today's press conference until November 4.
The discount airline did not comment on the reason for the delay.
Kiwi was scheduled to present today a financing plan that would allow the carrier to rehire laid-off employees and restart its operations.
Kiwi said it expected the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Newark to approve a $5 million debtor-in-possession financing commitment from the Wasatch Group.
Kiwi filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on September 30, 1996 under a $40 million debt load.
